lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is wider across the mid-torso and becomes narrower/more compressed as they approach the neck and shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the upper dorsal section of the fourth line from the posterior end of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: An isolated, truncated white segment (dash) is visible on the upper haunch between the first and second primary vertical lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch, superior to the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Single white spot on the cheek inferior to the eye; white transverse marking across the bridge of the muzzle; white patches on the medial surfaces of the limbs.
